decisions.statement: The seat active most recently comes first.
Two seats active at the same moment are ordered by agent id.
Ordering leaves the list handed in unchanged.
A seat with no proxy is no live seat.
A seat whose process answers no signal is no live seat.
A live seat has the version its proxy is running.
A live seat has the agent id the seat is reached by.
A seat with no name is live under a null name.
The live seats have the order the agents arrived in.
A process is asked about only where its seat has a proxy.
A caller hands in the read answering the values a seat has.
A caller hands in the test answering whether a process is alive.
Nothing here reads the seat roster.
Nothing here reaches `utils-process/pid-signal` for the liveness test.

definition: the seats running a gateway process that is alive
